concerns.text: The GSM8K parquet files are listed with `streaming=False`, which will load the entire dataset into memory. Given the 7 GB RAM limit, this contradicts the claim that streaming is used to stay within RAM constraints and will likely cause out‑of‑memory failures.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 1 description (fixed‑density baselines) and overall resource bounding statement
concerns.text: Running 5 retaining ratios × 5 seeds (25 training runs) each up to 10 epochs on a 2‑core CPU within a single 6‑hour CI wall‑clock window is unrealistic. Even with a lightweight diffusion model, the cumulative compute exceeds the allotted time budget, violating the computational resource bounding requirement (FR‑005, VI).

The plan asserts that the entire experiment suite (phases 0‑5) will complete on a GitHub Actions runner limited to 2 CPU cores, ≤7 GB RAM, and a 6‑hour wall‑clock limit, yet the described experimental design (multiple runs, adaptive scheduler, statistical analysis) exceeds what can be feasibly executed within those constraints.
